findings.current:
So the Blood Lord had crushed him.

More thoroughly than before.
findings.defect: “Than before” invents an earlier beating; at their first meeting, the Blood Lord only watched from afar.
findings.rationale: 더욱 철저하게 intensifies the second encounter without establishing a prior attack.
findings.replacement:
So the Blood Lord had crushed him.

Thoroughly.

findings.current: Over his shoulder, two voices rang out, old yet clear.
findings.defect: Omits that Cheongpung’s whole body is surrounded by the qi of the Zaha Divine Technique.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies the technique and its visible effect on Cheongpung.
findings.replacement: Over Cheongpung’s shoulder, two voices rang out, old yet clear. The qi of the Zaha Divine Technique enveloped his entire body.
findings.source: 자하신공(紫霞神功)의 기운을 전신에 두른 청풍의 어깨너머로, 노쇠하지만 맑은 두 줄기의 음성이 울려 퍼졌다.

findings.current: “Hong Dao. Burn the bastard who killed that monk to a fucking crisp. Don’t leave so much as a hair.”
findings.defect: The imperative makes Hong Dao sound like the person ordered to act, although he is the monk whose killer Jeok intends to burn.
findings.rationale: Jeok names Hong Dao, then gives the instruction he claims to have received in the dream. The added “fucking” also intensifies the source’s profanity.
findings.replacement: “Hong Dao. He told me to burn the bastard who killed that monk to a crisp, without leaving so much as a hair.”
findings.source: “굉도. 그 땡중을 죽인 개자식을 털끝 하나 남기지 않고 태워 버리라고.”

findings.current: Three of them were leading figures among the Three Saints, each fully comparable to the foremost of the Ten Kings.
findings.defect: Makes all three members of the Three Saints and places the foremost of the Ten Kings outside that count.
findings.rationale: The source counts three exceptional masters within the seven, including the foremost of the Ten Kings alongside those of the Three Saints.
findings.replacement: Among them were members of the Three Saints and the foremost of the Ten Kings, a master fully their equal.
findings.source: 심지어 그중 셋은 제각각 삼성의 일익이자 그들과 충분히 비견될 십왕의 수좌(首座)였으니

findings.current: There were more than ten of them. He could also feel someone else behind them, standing as rigid as a fortress and exuding suffocating demonic qi.
findings.defect: Assigns the rigid stance and demonic qi to the person behind the Black Ghosts instead of to the Black Ghosts.
findings.rationale: 그들 refers to the Black Ghosts; the other person is behind them.
findings.replacement: There were a dozen or so of them, standing like an iron wall and exuding suffocating demonic qi. He could sense someone else behind them, too.
findings.source: 그 숫자만 무려 십여 기에 달한다는 것과 철벽처럼 우뚝 선 채 숨 막히는 마기를 내뿜고 있는 그들의 뒤에 또 다른 누군가가 있다는 사실도 함께.

findings.current:
Gritting his teeth, the Blood Lord poured all his seething fury into his hand.

KWA-ANG!

Jin Taekyung was driven back ten steps with a thunderous boom.
findings.defect: Drops the Blood Lord’s action of wrenching his hand free, which causes Taekyung to be driven back.
findings.rationale: 손을 떨쳤다 is an action at the point of contact, not merely energy gathered in his hand.
findings.replacement:
Gritting his teeth, the Blood Lord wrenched his hand free with all the fury surging through him.

KWA-ANG!

Jin Taekyung was driven back ten steps with a thunderous boom.
findings.source:
일순간, 이를 악문 혈주는 전신에 들끓어 오르는 분노를 실어 손을 떨쳤다.

쾅!

굉음과 함께 열 걸음을 물러난 진태경을 향해

summary: The draft changes several actions and subjects, obscures the balance of the encirclement, and omits Cheongpung’s technique.
